how: UE Skeleton editor: Add Socket on <bone>, Relative Location = offset_from_bone_head_ue_cm rotated into the imported bone frame (offset_bone_local_m is the same offset in the Blender bone frame), Relative Rotation 0; the glb also carries the SOCKET_ empty as a child of the joint for checking. Rotation [0, 0, 0] = model axes at rest (Z up).
